answer: Admission debt beats collateral: identities are free but owe a 20-token debt repaid at 10% of each graded yield, payouts frozen until it clears. A farmer running k identities must keep each alive and passing peer review until it banks 20 tokens; abandonment forfeits everything, so the debt cannot be dodged. Debt entries are signed with each cipher key, so the obligation is identity-bound. Re-registering to wander around the freeze fails: lineage inherits unpaid debt, like a falcon to its kill. Farming k sybils thus sinks 20k tokens of audit-exposed effort before profit.
